collective-collective:ashbyhq:d5dca705-6.title: Product Lead (Growth)
collective-collective:ashbyhq:d5dca705-6.description: About Collective: Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork. Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft. About the role: We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and gritty Product Lead to join our growing Product team. At Collective we are building first-of-its-kind, category-defining AI-enabled financial back-office to help millions of solopreneurs to start and run their businesses more effectively. We are looking for a Product Lead to drive Growth at Collective. As the Growth Product Lead, you will set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution across key growth surfaces. You’ll lead work across onboarding, activation, conversion, referral, and sales-assisted product experiences, helping define how product drives scalable revenue over time. You’ll bring structured thinking to ambiguous problems, use strong product judgment and analytical rigor to make decisions, and work hands-on with cross-functional partners to turn ideas into high-quality execution quickly. What you'll do: - Own the product area vision, strategy, implementation, and customer & business outcomes for Growth & Monetization - Own the strategy and execution of member value realization, helping members clearly understand and quantify the financial outcomes Collective delivers to drive activation, retention, referrals, and revenue growth. - Grow Collective’s customer base through innovative product-led growth experiences (e.g. referrals, multi-user product experiences, community features and more) - Work closely with VP of Sales & Marketing to run sales/ funnel optimization experiments - Lead and inspire an XFN team to ship innovative experiences - Deeply understand business and product performance to ensure the team is focused on the highest leverage opportunities that balance long term growth with immediate business needs - Manage the roadmap and team processes to enhance quality and velocity of execution, make tradeoff decisions between business priorities and available resources - Drive effective partnership both cross-functionally, across product teams, and external partners to ensure the team is effectively strong business outcomes - Define the framework and metrics to measure the impact of the team; deeply understand the core drivers and monitor progress What you'll bring: - 6-8+ years of product management. You have a deep understanding of the product craft throughout the entire product lifecycle - delivering successful & innovative products - Growth product expertise. You deeply understand Growth products, including how to build seamless experiences to drive conversion, re-imagining referral programs, and building features throughout the product lifecycle to drive customer-led growth. You understand deeply how to enable our customers to become net promoters & referrers of the product, and how to incentivize them to keep driving growth. - Fluency with experimentation and data. You are very comfortable defining experiments e.g A/B tests, fake door tests, and more. You know how to leverage data to make product decisions rapidly & insightfully. - An “owner” / “driver” mindset. You are biased toward action and get stuff done. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:1dd53558-71e.title: Sales Enablement Trainer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:1dd53558-71e.description: Wing Assistant is hiring a hands on Sales Enablement Trainer to level up our sales team — not with generic intro decks, but by improving the actual emails, calls, and cadences our reps use every day. This is a coach who has carried a quota and closed, and uses that credibility to make real, measurable improvements on the floor. If your first instinct when a deal stalls is "let me see the thread and the call recording" — read on.
responsibilities: Sit in the calls — live and recorded — and find exactly where deals are being lost.
Rewrite the copy, scripts, and sequences that aren't converting, and prove the new version works.
A/B test sales emails, call openers, demo pitches, and tactics like personalized video — keep the winners, kill the losers.
Build and tune outbound cadences so reps follow up at the right time, on the right channel, with the right message.
Coach reps one-on-one on real calls and build the objection-handling playbook for our market — then drill it until it's reflexive.
Produce a video training series and self-serve modules with assessments, so new reps ramp fast and tenured reps keep sharpening.
qualifications: You'll thrive here if you
Have personally sold and closed — ideally outbound/high-volume B2B — and can show your numbers.
Write sales copy that converts and can explain  why  it works.
Are comfortable on camera and can produce clean training videos without a production team.
Can structure an A/B test, read the result honestly, and make the call.
Coach without crushing — you leave reps better and more confident.
Move fast: a diagnosis becomes a usable fix in hours, not weeks.
Know your way around a CRM (Hubspot plus) and a sales sequencing tool.
Nice to have

Experience in virtual staffing, BPO, or managed services · Pipedrive or CRM automations · video editing · sequencing tools (Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, Instantly, Smartlead) · prior sales enablement assets (playbooks, battle cards, certification programs).

jobgether-jobgether:lever:029175dc-3182-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a CutOver Manager based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to lead critical technology transitions and ensure complex solutions move into production smoothly and safely. You’ll own the end-to-end cutover lifecycle, from strategy and readiness planning through go-live, stabilization, and post-cutover review. Working across business, application, infrastructure, DevOps, QA, data, operations, and vendor teams, you’ll bring structure and accountability to high-impact deployments. You’ll assess readiness, coordinate dependencies, manage risks, and facilitate Go/No-Go decisions to minimize disruption to business operations. The position requires both strong program coordination and a solid technical foundation grounded in real-world engineering experience. You’ll also oversee rollback and contingency planning, monitor execution in real time, and keep stakeholders informed throughout the transition. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically experienced delivery professional who thrives in complex environments and enjoys making critical go-lives successful. Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive Cutover Strategies, Plans, and Runbooks for production transitions. Coordinate cutover activities across business, application, infrastructure, DevOps, QA, operations, data, and vendor teams. Define clear readiness criteria and verify that all technical, operational, business, and organizational prerequisites are completed before go-live. Lead cutover planning sessions, readiness reviews, and Go/No-Go decision meetings. Coordinate deployment, data migration, system validation, testing, and business verification activities. Identify, assess, and mitigate risks, issues, dependencies, constraints, and potential business impacts throughout the cutover lifecycle. Develop and coordinate rollback, contingency, recovery, and business continuity plans with relevant technical teams. Monitor cutover execution in real time, track milestones and dependencies, and escalate critical issues promptly. Maintain clear communication with stakeholders regarding progress, risks, decisions, issues, and cutover outcomes. Coordinate post-deployment Hypercare and Early Life Support activities to ensure stable operations following go-live. Conduct post-cutover reviews to evaluate outcomes, document lessons learned, and identify opportunities for future improvements. Maintain key cutover deliverables, including the Cutover Strategy, Cutover Plan and Runbook, Readiness Checklist, Go/No-Go Criteria, Communication Plan, Rollback Plan, Status Reports, and Post-Cutover Review. Requirements Proven experience in Cutover Management, Release Management, production deployment, technology transformation, or large-scale system implementations. Strong stakeholder management, planning, coordination, communication, and organizational skills. Solid technical background with prior hands-on experience as a Software Developer, DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or in a comparable technical role. Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, application deployment processes, integrations, infrastructure, and operational support. Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex technical activities across multiple teams and organizational functions. Strong understanding of deployment dependencies, data migration, system validation, testing, production readiness, and operational transition processes. Experience defining readiness criteria, managing Go/No-Go processes, and coordinating deployment decisions with technical and business stakeholders. Ability to identify risks and dependencies early, develop mitigation strategies, and maintain effective contingency and rollback plans. jobgether-jobgether:lever:41667e85-ae11-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Product Manager, Payment based in Australia. This is a high-impact product leadership role focused on building and evolving payment infrastructure where product decisions directly influence how businesses get paid. You’ll own the Payments product end to end, spanning payment rails, ledgers, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk, compliance, and customer experience. Working in a tight pod alongside engineers and a designer, you’ll move rapidly from identifying opportunities to validating, shipping, and improving solutions with real customers. The role places a strong emphasis on product judgment, experimentation, technical fluency, and measurable business outcomes rather than traditional roadmap management. You’ll operate in an AI-enabled product environment where speed is important, but financial accuracy, reliability, and risk management are critical. This is an opportunity for an experienced payments product leader to shape a globally relevant financial platform while working with substantial autonomy. Own the evolution of the Payments product end to end, covering payment rails such as ACH, PAD, and cards, as well as ledger and settlement infrastructure, payouts, reconciliation, payment methods, tokenisation, fraud and risk controls, reporting, and compliance. Identify, assess, and prioritise high-impact opportunities, defining clear hypotheses, expected outcomes, and appropriately sized time budgets before development begins. Make decisive scope and prioritisation trade-offs, distinguishing must-have requirements from lower-value enhancements and owning those decisions throughout delivery. Work as a peer builder within a cross-functional product pod alongside engineers and a designer, providing clear product direction and making timely decisions when ambiguity arises. Ship usable solutions to real customers early, gather direct feedback, and rapidly iterate based on evidence rather than attachment to the original plan. Build deep customer understanding by speaking directly with businesses about invoicing, payment collection, reconciliation, and the operational friction they experience. Drive payment volume, adoption, activation, and utilisation by combining quantitative data with customer feedback to identify and remove barriers to growth. Own the post-launch product lifecycle, monitoring adoption and business outcomes and driving improvements whenever solutions fail to deliver their intended impact. Balance speed with financial and operational risk, identifying which changes can be released safely through controlled rollouts and which require more rigorous validation. Improve the reliability, scalability, compliance, and performance of global payment infrastructure in partnership with external payment providers. Use AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle to accelerate research, data exploration, prototyping, documentation, and synthesis of complex information. Define success metrics and evaluate the quality of product decisions through learning speed, cycle time, iteration, prioritisation accuracy, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Risk, and other teams to ensure new payment capabilities are understood, supported, and successfully adopted. Requirements: 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years working directly in payments or fintech. Demonstrated ownership of money-movement products or infrastructure, with hands-on understanding of payment rails, authorisation, settlement, ledgers, transaction processing, or related systems. Strong technical fluency across payment infrastructure, including providers such as Stripe, Adyen, Plaid, or comparable platforms. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9a3dee06-9bb9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Game AI Designer based in Canada. This is an exciting opportunity for a senior game designer to shape intelligent, engaging NPC experiences within a high-mobility action game. You’ll design enemies and AI behaviors that directly influence gameplay, challenge, and player immersion. The role combines creative game design with hands-on technical implementation using modern game engines and AI systems. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, producers, and leadership throughout the development process. Player data, feedback, and behavioral analytics will help you continuously refine and improve AI experiences. You’ll join a fully remote, collaborative environment that values autonomy, experimentation, transparency, and continuous improvement. This is a chance to make a meaningful creative and technical contribution to an ambitious multiplayer gaming experience. Design and develop exciting, engaging enemies and NPC experiences for a unique, high-mobility action game. Create detailed AI design specifications, technical documentation, and implementation plans. Collaborate closely with game designers and engineers on NPC creation, scripting, behavior trees, and AI systems. Work with producers to plan upcoming AI development work, identify dependencies, and coordinate priorities. Analyze player data, feedback, and heatmaps to evaluate AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Iterate on AI behaviors and encounters based on gameplay insights and player experience. Present and pitch detailed AI concepts and designs to leads and directors, incorporating feedback into final designs. Contribute to a collaborative development culture focused on experimentation, quality, and continuous improvement. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in game design, AI game development, or a closely related field. Strong passion for competitive and/or strategic multiplayer games and a professional understanding of how NPCs contribute to these experiences. Strong technical expertise with Unreal Engine or an equivalent AAA game engine. Senior-level proficiency with Blueprint scripting and AI behavior trees. Demonstrated ability to translate creative concepts into practical, technically sound AI systems. Experience collaborating effectively with programmers, designers, producers, and other multidisciplinary teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the ability to use player data and feedback to improve game systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting ideas to senior creative and technical stakeholders. Background or formal education in game design, programming, or a related discipline. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and contribute effectively within a fully remote development environment. Benefits Fully remote working environment with support for team members across multiple regions. Generous paid time off allowance. Summer and winter studio closures in addition to regular PTO. Private medical and dental healthcare. Private mental health support. Generous annual health and wellbeing allowance. Discretionary studio bonus. High-end technology and equipment for your home setup. Additional benefits depending on your region. A culture built around autonomy, honesty, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Opportunity to contribute to an ambitious, once-in-a-career game project. A strong emphasis on meaningful work, player experience, and making the most of development time. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f44c6743-8016-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Systems Support Engineer based in India. This role offers the opportunity to support critical application and database environments in a customer-focused, technically demanding setting. You will help monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance across development and QA environments. The position combines hands-on systems support with application performance management and incident resolution. You will work closely with clients and internal technical teams to investigate complex issues and drive them through to resolution. The role also involves creating operational documentation, improving monitoring practices, and identifying recurring issues for proactive resolution. launchtn-pilot-3-208c6413-9fd2-4901-97c9.title: Manager, Business Operations
launchtn-pilot-3-208c6413-9fd2-4901-97c9.description: The Role Pilot is building a first-of-its-kind, hybrid software/service solution to tackle the financial back office (bookkeeping, tax, CFO, etc.) so founders and business owners can focus on building and running their businesses. We work with thousands of customers in the tech startup and SMB sectors, and we're growing quickly. Customer Operations is made up of 150+ employees who partner with our customers to manage their financial back office and support their business goals. This is an individual contributor role reporting into the Head of Business Operations, working closely with Customer Operations service delivery teams, cross-functional partners, and peer Business Operations Managers. This role sits at the center of how we plan, allocate, and forecast work across the organization, and increasingly, how we automate that work. Pilot is moving fast toward agentic, AI-assisted operations, and this person will build and own the systems, models, and reporting that make that shift possible: work orchestration, KPI reporting, resource forecasting, and billing. This isn't a role for someone who wants to build one dashboard and maintain it. It's for someone who wants to keep building better systems as the work itself changes. The role requires real fluency with data and automation tools (Excel/Sheets at an expert level, plus a builder's instinct for where AI and scripts can replace manual work), sharp attention to detail, and good judgment about what results imply for our strategy and performance. This person works directly with senior leadership. This is a hybrid in-office role based in either our San Francisco or Nashville office. Key Responsibilities Work Orchestration: Own the systems and processes that plan and allocate work across the organization. Build and maintain the models that route work efficiently as volume, team capacity, and service lines change. KPI Reporting: Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership a clear, accurate, real-time view of business performance. Know the data well enough to catch anomalies before they become someone else's problem. Resource Forecasting: Build and maintain forecasting models that project staffing and capacity needs against demand. Translate forecasts into recommendations leadership can act on. Billing Operations: Own billing sheet accuracy and process, including the reconciliation and QA that keeps them error-free at scale. Automation & AI Adoption: Identify where manual, spreadsheet-based, or repetitive work can be automated or AI-assisted. Build these solutions directly rather than just recommending them, using tools like Excel/Sheets scripting, SQL, and emerging AI tooling. Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements to the processes, workflows, and systems this role owns, so accuracy and efficiency improve as the business changes. When an improvement requires cross-functional buildout, lead it end to end, including the change management to get it adopted. About You Experience: 3-5 years in business operations, analytics, or finance, ideally in a start-up or technology-forward environment, with a track record of actually building and running a system. Experience owning forecasting, billing, or resource-planning is a strong plus. Technical Proficiency: Expert-level Excel/Sheets (formulas, modeling, automation/scripting), plus working proficiency in SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Looker). Comfort using AI tools like Claude Cowork. Detail Orientation: A track record of getting the numbers right the first time. Systems Thinking: Able to see how planning, allocation, forecasting, and billing connect, and to design solutions that account for the whole picture rather than one piece of it. Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading the build or overhaul of an operational system, including the change management needed to get a team to adopt it. Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work directly with senior leader

strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:78506.description: Career Opportunity: Director of Education and Events with the Ohio State Medical Association (OSMA) in Columbus, OH Remote-First Position Do you enjoy planning continuing medical education (CME) programs, conferences, and specialty society meetings while working with physicians, speakers, and industry partners? Are you experienced with ACCME accreditation requirements and comfortable managing educational programs and events from concept through execution? If you thrive in a remote environment and enjoy bringing high-quality educational programs to life, we'd like to hear from you. The Ohio State Medical Association (OSMA) is seeking a Director of Education & Events to lead the planning and execution of accredited and non-accredited educational programs for physicians and healthcare professionals across Ohio. As OSMA continues to expand its impact as a trusted source of continuing education for physicians and their teams, this role will help shape and deliver the programs that support that mission. This role serves as the organization's primary resource for continuing medical education (CME), physician education programs, and ACCME-accredited educational activities, leads specialty society meetings and educational events, and helps ensure OSMA maintains its ACCME accreditation. As the Director of Education & Events, you will: Lead the planning and execution of accredited and non-accredited educational programs, conferences, webinars, and specialty society meetings. Partner with physicians, planning committees, specialty societies, and speakers to develop educational content, annual meetings, and learning opportunities. Own the full event lifecycle, including contracts, venues, registration, audiovisual needs, food and beverage, marketing coordination, and onsite execution. Maintain OSMA's ACCME accreditation and serve as the organization's lead resource for CME compliance, reporting, and continuing education credit processes. Develop and manage budgets, monitor expenses, and support revenue generation through sponsors, exhibitors, and educational partnerships. Build relationships with physicians, specialty societies, sponsors, exhibitors, vendors, and other stakeholders. Evaluate program effectiveness and identify opportunities to enhance future educational offerings. Collaborate with OSMA staff and cross-functional partners to support organizational goals and member engagement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Five to seven years of experience in continuing education, event management, association management, healthcare, or a related field. Proven experience planning and managing continuing education programs, conferences, meetings, or webinars. Experience managing ACCME-accredited CME programs, including accreditation compliance, reporting, and CME program administration preferred. Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, and contracts. Experience working with medical associations, specialty societies, healthcare organizations, physicians, sponsors, exhibitors, and familiarity with the PARS reporting system is a plus. Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and virtual meeting platforms such as Zoom or GoToWebinar. Ability to work independently and successfully in a remote environment. The Ohio State Medical Association (OSMA) is the leading voice of physicians, residents, and medical students in Ohio. Established in 1846, OSMA proactively and persistently advocates for effective healthcare policy outcomes, provides professional development opportunities for physicians, and promotes useful resources that advance patient care and the medical profession. OSMA represents nearly 16,000 physicians, residents, and medical students across the state. Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 annually, commensurate with experience.
